easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter.
description:
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Vesuvan Shapeshifter. Choose to have Vesuvan Shapeshifter enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
